packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions only to releases at least two weeks old (Section 9 supply chain, A94). CI checks each pinned SHA against its tag (infra/security/src/action-pins.ts).
typescript-eslint caps TypeScript below 6.1 (ADR 0001). Hold TypeScript until it widens.
stylelint-use-logical-spec supports stylelint below 17 (ADR 0001, deviation 4). Hold stylelint until it widens.
